title: 第19章 夸父不朽巫身彻底失控第20章 注定要战李玄霄机缘竟在此
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
听闻此言，全场死寂。
众人都惊叹于这大罗修士的勇气。
可众人不知的是，这位大罗也不是什么真的散修，他来自妖族天庭，为的便是让这九凤大巫暴走，有理由将其留在蓬莱仙岛！
在最终决战前，巫族若接连损失数位顶尖大巫，这对于妖族来说将是极大的利好。
“九凤大巫，且三思。”
李玄霄见此，为避免牵连自己，只得轻声提醒了一句。
九凤闻言，瞳孔猛地一震！
自己好像落入了圈套之中？
但，眼下该如何破局？虽然她九凤战力彪悍，可真的没有什么能够拿得出手的宝贝，她下意识地向李玄霄投去了求助的目光。
见这九凤大巫竟向自己投来了求助目光，李玄霄不由苦笑。
我就一截教记名弟子啊，区区真仙初期修为，当真是误入高端局！
不过事情既然如此，李玄霄也只得缓缓起身：“九凤大巫，你现在身上可是并未携带上品先天灵宝级别的宝贝？”
不等九凤回答，李玄霄看向众人：“诸位皆知，巫族坐拥洪荒大地，九凤大巫又是巫族精锐，更是九黎部族族长，既然九凤大巫开口了，自不会是强夺，而是竞价。”
九凤闻言，心中有所计较，思虑片刻后郑重道：“两件上品先天灵宝！等道珍会结束，你们随我回巫族祖地去取。”
显然，九黎部落之中也没有这等宝贝，她也只能去求祖巫了。
不过若是为了后羿的遗物，倒也没有什么不值当。
而那来自天庭的大罗修士闻言，却是出乎意料的没有继续加价，反倒是直接转身坐下。
这让准备看好戏的众人觉得有一丝虎头蛇尾。
但事情又岂会这般简单！
石台上的中年女修回过神来，忙道：“还有哪位道友出价？若是没有，这柄射日神弓，便归九凤大巫所有了！”

连问三声，无人应答。
“好！恭喜九凤大巫竞得射日神弓！”
中年女修一锤定音。
李玄霄坐在一旁，心中也松了口气。
但其心里，却隐隐生出了一丝不对劲。
这丝疑虑刚冒出来，便被石台上中年女修的声音打断了。
“咱们的压轴重宝，还剩最后两件，每一件都足以震动洪荒，诸位道友，可千万不要错过！”
“接下来这第二件压轴重宝，来历更是非同小可！同样巫妖战场，乃是巫族十二祖巫之后，最顶尖的大巫，夸父的不朽巫身！”
“轰！”
这句话如同惊雷炸响，整个会场都瞬间炸开了锅，比刚才射日神弓出现时的震动还要剧烈数倍！
夸父！
这可是巫族赫赫有名的逐日大巫！
其一身修为直追祖巫，肉身强横无匹，一身力之法则修至化境，追着金乌跑遍九天十地洪荒三界，哪怕最终死于太阳真火之下，其巫躯也不朽不灭，是洪荒之中最顶尖的炼体至宝！
对于炼体修士而言，哪怕只是得到夸父巫躯的一块碎骨，都能借此参悟力之法则，淬炼出无上肉身，更何况是完整的不朽巫躯？
若是能将其炼化，肉身强度甚至能直追巫族大巫，同阶之内，几乎无人能伤！
content_en:
Hearing this, the whole place fell silent.
Everyone was amazed at the courage of this Da Luo monk.
But what everyone doesn't know is that this Da Luo is not a real casual cultivator. He comes from the Demon Clan Heavenly Court, and his purpose is to make the Nine Phoenix Great Witch go berserk and have a reason to keep him in Penglai Immortal Island!
Before the final battle, if the Witch Clan loses several top wizards one after another, this will be a great benefit to the Monster Clan.
"Nine Phoenix Great Witch, please think twice."
Seeing this, Li Xuanxiao could only remind him softly in order to avoid implicating himself.
When Jiufeng heard this, his pupils suddenly trembled!
Do you seem to have fallen into a trap?
But, how to break the situation now? Although her Jiu Feng was powerful, she really didn't have any valuable treasures that she could use. She subconsciously cast a look at Li Xuanxiao for help.
Seeing that the Nine Phoenix Great Witch actually looked at him for help, Li Xuanxiao couldn't help but smile bitterly.
I just teach the registered disciples, who are only in the early stages of cultivation as a True Immortal, but they really entered the high-end game by mistake!
But since things were like this, Li Xuanxiao could only stand up slowly: "Jiu Feng Great Witch, are you not carrying a top-grade innate spiritual treasure with you now?"
Without waiting for Jiufeng's answer, Li Xuanxiao looked at everyone: "As you all know, the Wu Clan sits on the ancient land. The Great Witch Jiu Feng is the elite of the Wu Clan and the leader of the Jiuli Tribe. Since the Great Witch Jiu Feng has spoken, it will not be a robbery, but a bidding."
Hearing this, Jiufeng had something to worry about. After thinking for a moment, he said solemnly: "Two top-grade innate spiritual treasures! When the Daozhen meeting is over, you can follow me back to the ancestral land of the Wu clan to get them."
Obviously, there is no such treasure in the Jiuli tribe, so she can only ask the ancestral witch for help.
But if it's for Hou Yi's relics, it's not worth it.
When the Da Luo monk from Heaven heard this, he unexpectedly did not continue to increase the price. Instead, he turned around and sat down.
This made everyone who was ready to watch the show feel a bit anticlimactic.
But how can things be so simple!
The middle-aged female cultivator on the stone platform came to her senses and said hurriedly: "Is there any other fellow Taoist who bids? If not, this sun-shooting bow will belong to the Great Witch of Jiufeng!"
I asked three times, but no one answered.
"Okay! Congratulations to the Great Witch of the Nine Phoenixes for winning the Sun Shooting Bow!"
The middle-aged female cultivator made the final decision.
Li Xuanxiao sat aside and breathed a sigh of relief.
But something was vaguely wrong in his heart.
As soon as this doubt emerged, he was interrupted by the voice of a middle-aged female cultivator on the stone platform.
"We have the last two treasures left. Each one is enough to shock the world. Fellow Taoists, please don't miss it!"
"The origin of the second grand treasure that follows is even more extraordinary! The same Lich battlefield is the immortal witch body of Kuafu, the top witch after the twelve ancestral witches of the Wu clan!"
"Boom!"
These words were like a thunderous explosion, and the whole venue exploded in an instant, which was several times more violent than the shock when the Sun Shooting Divine Bow appeared just now!
Kuafu!
This is the famous Zhusun Great Witch of the Witch Clan!
His cultivation is on par with the ancestral witch, his physical body is unparalleled, and he has cultivated the laws of strength to the state of transformation. He chases the Golden Crow throughout the nine heavens and ten earths, and even if he eventually dies under the true fire of the sun, his witch body will remain immortal and immortal. He is the top body-refining treasure in the ancient world!
For a body-refining cultivator, even if they only get a broken bone from Kuafu's witch body, they can use it to understand the law of power and refine a supreme body, let alone a complete immortal witch body?
If it can be refined, its physical strength can even rival that of the Great Witch of the Witch Clan, and almost no one at the same level can hurt him!
